products.name: Grain
products.note: Meeting recording AI; highlight clips; CRM integration; consent and sharing

profile_text.body:
Grain is a San Francisco-based company, founded in 2018, that offers an AI meeting recorder and conversation intelligence platform. The company describes its product as capturing video calls, Slack huddles, and in-person meetings, then producing summaries, transcripts, and coaching suggestions. Grain says it serves any team that relies on meetings but specializes in small to mid-market and enterprise sales, customer success, and product teams. The platform supports transcription in over 130 languages, with the highest accuracy reported for English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, and Japanese.

The core product, also called Grain, records meeting content including video, desktop-captured audio, and transcripts, and is designed to pass that data to external AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT for further processing. Grain offers CRM integration, highlight clip creation, and consent and sharing controls. The company offers a free plan with unlimited meetings subject to a 45-minute meeting limit and 90-day history, while paid plans start at $15 per month per user and remove those limits while adding advanced AI and conversational intelligence features. Grain states that neither it nor its subprocessors use customer data for model training.

The site's held facts indicate Grain has a notable exposure footprint of 175 entries associated with California, which may reflect regulatory or legal activity in that state, though no specific litigation cases are recorded in the available data.
